  • Method Details

    • classPath

      public ClassPathTransform.Request.Builder classPath(List<Path> entries)
      The runtime class path, in the order the application's class loader searches it, the application's own output first: jars or directories. Required. Every class on it is part of the model that rewritten classes are verified against; only the entries a step names are rewritten.
      Parameters:
      entries - the class path entries
      Returns:
      this builder

    • outputDirectory

      public ClassPathTransform.Request.Builder outputDirectory(Path directory)
      Where rewritten copies are written: each under a subdirectory named by its entry's index in the class path, with the entry's own file name. Required. The caller owns the directory and cleans it. It must not hold an entry of the class path, such as a copy that an earlier run wrote there, because a run replaces and deletes files in it.
      Parameters:
      directory - the output directory
      Returns:
      this builder

    • stripLocalVariables

      public ClassPathTransform.Request.Builder stripLocalVariables(Collection<Path> thirdPartyJars)
      Strip the local-variable tables of the classes in these jars: third-party jars only, never the application's output, a module of the application's own build or a directory. Default: none.

      A non-empty collection enables the step. Each jar must be an entry of the class path. The step drops LocalVariableTable, LocalVariableTypeTable, CharacterRangeTable, the type annotations of code and the invisible type annotations, and keeps line numbers, source file names, parameter names, signatures and every other annotation. It strips nothing, and the result carries a warning, when the class path holds a library that reads local-variable tables at run time.

      Parameters:
      thirdPartyJars - the jars whose classes are stripped
      Returns:
      this builder

      public ClassPathTransform.Request.Builder parallelism(int threads)
